scientific_integrity: Analytic three-eigenspace derivation, strict convexity, and all-face KKT inequalities are given; the reproduced full-edge gradient and exact polynomial tests are corroborative. No outside validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for a complete graph with a marked triangle, linear prices and total effective resistance; not arbitrary graph prices or nonlinear costs. Finite computation corroborates rather than proves the all-size theorem.
title: An exceptional two-stage support transition for resistance-optimal priced triangles in complete networks
